    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day

    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END AS __payment_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __refund_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_semantic_src_10000
)

SELECT

    , CAST(SUM(__refund_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__payment_cents), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount_rate

  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2024-09-02' AND '2024-09-02'
